statement: Let O be a neutral operator of norm at most one supported on Br(x), where r ≥ 2 and x has latitude index m. There are fixed constants b, C∗, and c = 8, independent of every tail order below, such that, if q > Crb(1 + m), the operator ∆q,d(O) = Uq,d(1)∗ OUq,d(1) − O 25 satisfies ∥∆q,d(O)∥ ≤ Crc 1 + m q2 , (4.11) inf A∈A(Br+R(x)) ∥∆q,d(O) − A∥ ≤ CDrc 1 + m q2 (1 + R)−D (R ≥ C∗(1 + r)). (4.12) In particular, it admits a decomposition ∆q,d(O) = X ν≥0 Dν, Dν ∈ A(BC∗2ν r(x)), ∥Dν∥ ≤ CDrc 1 + m q2 2−νD . (4.13) For |q − q′| ≤ 3, with the same d and identical northern slots, ∆q,d(O) − ∆q′,d(O) obeys all these estimates with q−2 replaced by q−3. In particular, for every fixed B, the shell decomposition can be chosen so that X ν≥0 (C∗2ν r)B ∥Dν∥ ≤ CBrB+c 1 + m q2 , (4.14) and the same moment estimate holds for the flux difference with q−3.
